Taseen Ahmed is a university student studying electrical engineering.
Taseen Ahmed has ADHD, which affects his concentration and leads to gaps in his studying and knowledge.
The AI Tutor software is designed to help students learn by asking questions and receiving explanations.
The funding goal for The AI Tutor project was $70,614.

The software allows users to get help with any question or topic they are struggling with.

Training a machine learning model requires significant computer processing power.
The software aims to change how people learn and make education more accessible.
